# EnTT v4.0.0

This directory contains the vendored headers of the **EnTT** Entity-Component-System (ECS) library.

- **Upstream Repository**: https://github.com/skypjack/entt
- **Release Version**: `v4.0.0`
- **Release Commit**: `85c6bba014049b5de8fad49d25424df2f1f6a8c1`
- **License**: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

## Layout
- `include/entt/`: The complete EnTT header tree including core, entity, meta, signal, locator, process, resource, poly, and stl submodules.

## Update Instructions
To update to a newer version:
1. Clone the desired release tag from https://github.com/skypjack/entt.
2. Replace `include/entt/` with the contents of `src/entt/`.
3. Update this `README.md` and verify `LICENSE`.
